name: FREN 5272
title: French Philosophy
description: (Also offered as CLCS 5272.) Introduction to the French philosophical tradition from the Enlightenment to the post-structuralist revolution. Topics include theories of freedom, knowledge, power, language, subjectivity, sexuality, and the mind/body dialectic. Critical practice applied to literature, film, and other genres. Taught in English.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
